items.name: Hero Sections
items.description: A growing set of premium hero section variants with polished copy layout, CTA placement, and product demo framing for modern React landing pages.

items.name: Kanban Board
items.description: An editable task board with movable cards, compact filters, and task details in a focused animated dialog.

items.name: KPI Overview
items.description: KPI cards with animated values, compact headers, bar charts, gauges, trend charts, support metrics, and account summaries.

items.name: Log Explorer
items.description: A compact execution log with severity filters, search, pause and resume, live following, and morphing payload details.

items.name: Model Picker
items.description: A searchable model picker with provider logos, grouped options, keyboard selection, and a fixed bottom search field.

items.name: Morphic Card Modal
items.description: Apple-style card expansion modal. A card morphs into a full overlay using shared layout animation — no position hacks, just framer layoutId.

items.name: Morphic Tooltip
items.description: A shared-layout tooltip primitive with one animated surface that morphs between triggers for polished hover and focus hints.

items.name: Performance Report
items.description: Compact reports with animated metrics, period comparisons, beUI controls, charts, and team leaderboards.

items.name: Pricing
items.description: Premium pricing blocks across sharp, interactive, and soft editions: an aurora plan duo, flowing single card, technical command deck, live pricing ledger, upgrade carousel, usage slider, and animated plans grid.

items.name: Progressive blur highlight
items.description: A blur-revealed paragraph where selected phrases highlight in sequence and remain marked without cycling away.

items.name: Questionnaire
items.description: Composable, animated question-and-answer cards that help agents collect context and continue with clear instructions.

items.name: Receipt
items.description: A printed order receipt that feeds out of a printer slot, with line items, adjustments, a payment line, a barcode, and a status stamp.

items.name: Research Sources
items.description: A searchable reference library with source filters, readable excerpts, and context selection.

items.name: Segmented meter
items.description: A capacity meter split into colored segments, with a gliding tooltip, a linked legend, selection, and hover state you can share with tables or lists.

items.name: Sparkline
items.description: A compact trend line that draws in from the left and renders correctly before hydration.

items.name: Studio Background
items.description: The production WebGL runtime for responsive animated backgrounds created in beUI Studio.

items.name: Team calculator
items.description: An interactive seat calculator with automatic volume discounts, monthly and yearly billing, and a transparent live price breakdown.

items.name: Team Invites
items.description: Workspace invite blocks for adding teammates by email, picking roles, tracking seats, and sharing an invite link.

items.name: Tokenomics
items.description: Token distribution and vesting sections with linked, animated charts for launch pages and docs.

items.name: Usage Budget
items.description: A segmented usage meter with resource costs, animated totals, and an adjustable monthly budget.

items.name: Voice Conversation
items.description: A compact voice conversation card with an audio-reactive waveform, transcript, and session controls.

items.name: What's New
items.description: In-app release announcements that open from a corner teaser into a slide-by-slide spotlight of what changed.
